question: Where’s the closest hospital located east of Moltke Maize Maze, LLC, Rogers City, MI?
sql:
WITH origin AS (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.968943 45.435343)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois,origin
WHERE pois.amenity = 'hospital'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> origin.geometry ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Moltke Maize Maze, LLC, Rogers City, MI

poi.description: Annual Fall attraction. Enjoy a fun-filled day finding your way through the maze to discover items to solve 3 puzzles. Maze location varies slightly each year, but is in close proximity to this point & viewable from Curtis Rd.
